title: FCA charges individual with money laundering
summary: The FCA has charged Raymond Fieldhouse with a money laundering offence. Mr Fieldhouse is accused of laundering over £1.42m made from investment scams between 1 June 2017 and 1 August 2018.Mr Fieldhouse appeared at Stockport Magistrates’ Court on 17 November 2026 where he did not enter a plea. He was remanded in custody until his plea and trial preparation hearing on 22 December 2026 at Southwark Crown Court.Notes to editorsRaymond Fieldhouse was born on 29 April 1982. His nationality is British/Venezuelan. Mr Fieldhouse is accused of money laundering, contrary to section 327 of the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002. Fighting financial crime is a priority in the FCA’s 5-year strategy.The FCA enables a fair and thriving financial services market for the good of consumers and the economy. Find out more about the FCA.

title: Getting the full picture of trading in UK shares
summary: Why a complete picture mattersIn today’s market, firms can choose where and how they trade.Previous analysis has found that this competitive landscape benefits firms in wholesale markets. However, trading in UK shares has become more dispersed across venues and different ways of executing trades. Better information about market-wide activity helps firms assess liquidity, make investment decisions and understand trading costs. However, obtaining a complete picture of that activity has become more difficult.As we set out in CP26/30, overall trading activity in UK equity markets has been robust over recent years (see figure 1).
